scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: For 31 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2145 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

romania-transalpina.story: A one-way ride of 200 km, Novaci to Sebeş - roughly 2 h 41 in the saddle. On the way it passes Ranca, Urdele Pass and Obarsia Lotrului. The highest point is about 2,150 m. Urdele Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Rock Art of the Mediterranean Basin on the → Barranco de las Colochas-
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 36 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-rock-art-of-the-mediterranean-bas.story: A 201 km round trip from Tuéjar - roughly 3 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Barranco de las Colochas- Abrigo I, Balma de la fabriqueta, Peñón de Santo Espíritu and back through Balma de la fabriqueta. The highest point is about 950 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 33 km this is Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-potkuk-in-bitunja-old-city-of-dub.story: A 188 km round trip from Berkovići - roughly 3 h 14 in the saddle. On the way it passes Boljuni, Vjetrenica Cave, Old City of Dubrovnik and back through Vjetrenica Cave. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It crosses from Bosnia & Herzegovina into Croatia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Chattahoochee Gaps Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 13 km this is Chattahoochee Gaps Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Chattahoochee Gaps Road
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 22 km. 900 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Richard Russell Scenic Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 900 m come off over 12 km at around 7.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

chattahoochee-gaps-road.story: From Clayton it runs 88 km to Cleveland; allow about 1 h 42 of riding. The stops in between: Dillard and Hiawassee. The climb of the day is Unicoi Gap. It tops out at 900 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
